body: The transform of the spatial events did not match the existing controllers or the OpenXR convention. I fixed it by applying a corrective transform to each hand. Before this fix (you can see that -Z points upwards): After this fix (note that +Y points upwards and that -Z points forward): | | | | - | - | | Godot spatial events after fix | OpenXR convention | And here is a video showing the Spatial Events and the PSVR2 controllers side by side: you can see that the orientation now matches (aside from a small angular offset): https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/88166072-c101-4cfc-9fb3-c9e2bb8c2257
This should also set the `aim` pose, and we should either invalidate the grip and palm poses, or obtain those from hand tracking data.
If this is not active, should we still be setting poses? Or should they be invalidated? Not sure..
